description: Round 1. One gte-modernbert-base encoder (22 layers) with 5 score heads (one pass for all five attributes), input = [CLS] 'prompt <n> response <m> lines <k>' [SEP] prompt head+tail [SEP] response head+tail [SEP] truncated to 128 tokens (keeps the response). Trained 3 epochs (lr 3e-5, bs 32, ordinal-Gaussian targets sigma 0.6) on 7,338 deepseek-v4.1-flash hard labels (4,938 v1 silver, 2,400 new, v1 prompt, no seeds) + 220 gold (200 dev + 20 seeds, weight 5). Post-processing: helpfulness and correctness both output the mean of their two expected scores. ONNX int8 dynamic per-channel; mlp.Wo of layers 4/9/11/15 and the head kept fp32. Dev evidence: flash-only students 0.364/0.363 (2 seeds), +h/c blend 0.373/0.376; adding gold estimated by 5-fold CV on dev: 0.388 (blend). qwen labels (20k) and merged labels hurt the student (0.28-0.34); L18 -0.04; degraded synthetic pairs -0.035.

dev_metrics.estimate: 5-fold CV on dev (model for each fold trained without that fold), with h/c blend
